First release of agent-preflight.

It lists the instruction files, MCP servers, hooks and other config that a coding agent will load from your current folder, then flags anything that looks risky: files downloaded from the internet, agent files sitting in Downloads or temp folders, and text asking the agent to install or run things.

Binaries below are static builds for Linux and macOS (amd64 and arm64). Check them against checksums.txt. You can also install from source:

    go install github.com/sudodrift/agent-preflight/cmd/agent-preflight@v0.1.0
